lines.en: Every morning since my sex-life with a famous idol was reignited, there’s been a 30%% chance that I wake up beside her.
Today is not one of those days. Which is sad.
But it is also good because it means I get to do all of the things I can’t normally do while she’s still in here — like practice my kickboxing moves or grease the bearings of my secret skateboard.
I decide against doing any of that, though. And not just because I’m a liar either. It’s because I have a feeling I’m going to need to conserve my energy for when something bad happens today.
After all, it’d be a real shame if I was too busy doing skateboard maintenance to stop the ghost of my departed first love from molesting another girl I know. Especially one as hot as Tsuneyo.

That’s enough about Tsuneyo, though. Today is all about me. And if I’m going to practice this “self-care” thing I always hear Ami talking about, I shouldn’t be thinking about ethnically diverse bombshell teenagers.
I should be thinking about their breasts — which is a different thing entirely.
Now, please excuse me while I close the blinds and-
: You don’t say? You know, I know an excellent lawyer. So if you need some assistance in the case your production company is building against you-
Oh no.
How am I supposed to jerk off to this?
: Tsubasa, what are you doing here? I don’t remember putting my house on the market. But if Niki did, then I guess that’s fine because I need to win more points with her and Ami scares me now anyway.
: Ah, there you are. Your girlfriend here was just telling me all about your origin story together. It was all very exciting information that I definitely did not already have.
: Niki, you didn’t look into her eyes, did you?
: Nnnnnnnnnope.
: Good. Because that’s all it takes for her to gain control over someone. But I think where you’re looking right now might also do the trick, so chances are we’re both fucked.
: Oh, Akira. Once more, you fail to understand just how different your situation would be if I truly did control you.
: If you figure it out, let me know. I’ve been trying to control him since before his eyes were all squiggly like that. I think he’s just allergic to affection.
: Tsubasa, why are you even here? Because I don’t think giving my childhood friend legal advice is something on your endlessly packed to-do list.
: You’re absolutely correct. There are far too many instances of tormenting you on that list to make room for much else at all. I’m glad that you at least understand how busy I am, though.
: Well, you wouldn’t be Tsubasa if you weren’t inserting yourself into every single aspect of my life.
: And you wouldn’t be Akira if you weren’t inserting yourself into every girl in your life. To think you’d bag a fucking Tsukioka, though? That’s-
: Now, hold on one moment. Akira has not bagged me at all. In fact, I’m one of the few remaining people in this city he has not yet slept with.
: Impossible.
: I’m not the only one who caught the “yet” there, am I?
: He’s right. Disappointment is an inevitability with him. That “yet” is just foreshadowing.
: If I didn’t know any better, I might think you want me to sleep with him.
: How about an idol instead?
: Oh my.
: Niki, please don’t hit on any of the girls who come here to see me.

: Why not? It’s rare one enters that I can legally do that for. And if you’re going to cheat on me with an entire town, at least let me hook up with the rich lady out of spite. She knows a lawyer, Akira. And I’m in trouble.
: What’s going on out here? Is Aunt Niki trying to steal Touka’s mom from you as revenge for sleeping with the entire town?
: My fury knows no bounds.
: Why, if it isn’t Ami. That’s...quite the mug you have there.
: What mug? I didn’t- oh my fucking God. Ami!
: Thanks, Mrs. Tsukioka! I had it custom made. I got one for my dad too.
: I don’t want it. And I don’t want you to have it either.
: But Touka’s mom said it’s okay and she’s rich!
: SHE DID NOT SAY THAT! SHE JUST POINTED IT OUT!
: Frankly, I don’t see the issue so long as both parties consent. Incest dates back longer than any of us do and has been employed by nobility for thousands of years to keep bloodlines pure.
: Don’t say things that will encourage her! She’s bad enough as-is!
: You heard her, Dad. This is the only way to keep our bloodline pure.
: Wow. She does really like you, doesn’t she? My girls have never so much as looked at their father that way.
: Yeah, well, your girls have probably only seen their father a handful of times. I’m not even sure he’s real, to be honest.
: Perhaps you’d like to meet him? It would only be right in the event that our families start mixing gene pools.
: That’s it! Everybody dump your coffee back into the pot! I wouldn’t have made shit if I’d known we were going to start talking about gene pools!
: Oh, thank heavens. I was starting to worry that I was expected to drink this commoner swill.
: No offense, Nakayama-san. I do appreciate the gesture.
: You are not nearly as hot as I thought you were a minute ago.

: I don’t know, Aunt Niki. I’m kind of into it. And now that you’ve decided to throw away a fortune in exchange for love, I think this family might need to explore other options in terms of increasing our wealth.
: Merging with the Tsukiokas seems like a great way to tackle that. One that might even do away with the Arakawa pettanko gene once and for all.
: I should have just stayed in my room and fixed my skateboard...
: And I should have trusted my gut by not allowing any woman I have not personally approved to set foot in my house.
: Oh, was your name added to the deed? Because I’m pretty sure this house is just as much Touka’s mom’s as it is yours. Probably even more since her family basically owns Kumon-mi.

: I don’t give a shit what she owns, how rich she is, or how awesome her boobs are. You don’t walk into the home of my Akira, tell him it’s okay to fuck his daughter, and then offer up some sort of...bloodline swap.
: You respect my boundaries, you respect my boyfriend, or you get out. Got it? Same goes for whatever apparent spawns of yours wind up crawling in here next too.
: Uhh...Niki? As much as I appreciate this mother-bear side of you attempting to protect her den or whatever, Tsubasa is probably the last person you should speak to like that-
: I apologize. You are absolutely right and I was being inconsiderate after you went out of your way to extend a warm welcome to me. Please forgive me.
: Oh. What the fuck? How come you never stop doing things when I tell you to?
: I enjoy playing with you. You’re the only toy I have that I can use in public without being put on a registry.
: Yet, you are somehow not having sex.
: Impossible.
: Right?! That’s exactly what I said!
: Nakayama-san, would you permit me to borrow Akira for the rest of the day? On the condition of me continuing to not have sex with him, of course.
: No hand or mouth stuff either, right? I don’t want to agree if there’s going to be some sort of loophole you use to jerk him off in the parking lot.
: We don’t have a parking lot.
: I never specified that it had to be ours.
: I won’t lay a finger on him. And if he lays one on me, I’ll have him executed on the spot. Does that work?
: Perfectly, actually. Just make sure you feed him and give him water before you bring him back. He gets annoying if you don’t.
: Ami, can you get me a cup of coffee? Niki still hasn’t poured me one and I’m about to get really annoying.
: Sure. You can have mine.
: Take a sip out of that mug and I swear to fucking God I will have the rich lady bring you back as a eunuch.
: I suppose I can feed him. We have some kibble left over from when Tsukasa wanted a rabbit. Does that work for you, Akira?
: I’m not in trouble again, am I?
: Do you think it is within my power to discipline you?
: Yes.
: Good, because it is. But no. Quite the opposite, actually.
: I’d be willing to tell you more about exactly what I intend to-

: No need. Just get him out of here. Handcuff him if you have to. Then let me keep the handcuffs. He keeps trying to hug me in his sleep and his touch currently makes me sick. Except for when it doesn’t.
: Oh, I’ve heard about this before! The...tsundere, correct? You act distant, but deep down, you love him more than life itself.
: Right. But I’m also the childhood friend, so you forgot about the stereotype where I just get fucking shafted all the time.
: Correct me if I’m wrong, but I assumed being shafted would be a good thing.
: Hey, how come I don’t have a shadow?
We’re in the car now.
: Quite the character, that Niki girl. I can see why you two have been together for so long.
: You...can? Really? But all she did was berate me and tell us to not have sex.

: Yes. Well, it’s that whole “opposites attract” concept. She’s strong. You’re weak. So the two of you have developed some sort of lovey-dovey yet fiery symbiosis. Tell me — the sex is fantastic, isn’t it?
: Amazing.
: Better or worse than it is with my daughter?
: I haven’t had sex with your daughter.
: Oh, right. You just fingered her to completion in a residential alleyway. Silly me.
: Oh.
: Oh is right, you insatiable moron. I offer up my entire home to you to essentially do as you please with Touka, and you claim her in a public alleyway?
: I understand that recklessness is the name of your game, but if you’re going to put my family’s reputation in jeopardy, perhaps I should return you as a eunuch?
: I knew I was in trouble and you told me I wasn’t. I had a feeling something like this was going to happen today.

: I don’t know if you’ve realized this yet, Akira, but I say a lot of things. And your intuition is normally correct, but you normally act against it anyway with extremely minimal effort on my behalf.
: It makes me wonder if you’ve always been this easy to manipulate. Or what could be done to make you dance on my strings in even more extravagant fashion.
: That’s enough intimidation, though! Congratulations! You’re one step closer to deflowering an heiress! Who’d have ever thought you’d make it this high up the ladder with just your cock alone?!
: I thought you said that was enough intimidation?
: How many times do I need to say that sometimes I just say things before you understand that sometimes I just say things?
: I do wonder what comes next, though. If only Touka had lasted a few seconds longer. I imagine she’d have returned home with the phantom sensations of you thrusting into her still going strong.
: What do you mean “if only she lasted a few seconds longer?”
: What do you think I mean? Do you think I was somehow listening in? Or that Touka told me about your little wager? Which Tsubasa do you think I am right now?
: The kind who is currently kidnapping me for reasons I still don’t fully understand apart from just teaching me a lesson. That sort of thing doesn’t take all day, though.
: Well, I suppose that all depends on what type of lesson it is.
: Tsubasa, if you’re talking about Tsukasa again-
: Would you like to hear about the type of man she’s to be married to, Akira? Or would you prefer she’s just shipped off and treated as someone else’s property that you no longer have to worry about?
: Just fucking lie if you think that her suitor doesn’t want a girl who’s not a virgin. Don’t drag me into it.
: Hell, just call the whole thing off if you have to. You betting Tsukasa’s entire future on the inclusion of some random commoner makes literally no sense and I don’t get how that’s still your move.
: That’s just because you don’t understand the move. You’re not looking at the big picture.
: Then show me. Give me an actual reason to break if you’re so desperate to dismantle what little of myself I still have some control over.
: I intend to. That’s why you’ve been “kidnapped” and why you’ll be with me until nightfall. You’re welcome in advance, by the way. I wouldn’t do this for just anyone.
: Do what?
: I tempt you with a surprise this great and you immediately ask me to spoil it for you? Have you no restraint at all, Akira?
: I have some. It’s just weaker than the curious parts of me.
: Well, I don’t want any part in doing something that weakens you. I need you just the way you are if you’re going to give my family what it needs when push comes to shove.
: Right, yes. Sexual education lessons. The key to the Tsukioka Foundation’s future.
: Are you attempting to mock me right now?
: I’m just pointing out how ridiculous all of this is. Tsukasa is Tsukasa.

: And Tsukasa is a sexually curious brat who’s already much more mentally mature than a handful of the girls you’re presently sleeping with. It’s not like I’m asking you to bed Chika’s sister. Bless her soul.
: You’re overestimating just how mature Tsukasa is. She’s still a kid at the end of the day.
: And so were you when you became a man. But now, you’re the most deeply loved person I have ever encountered.
: I’m a monster now, Tsubasa. And if that’s what you want your daughter to become, then maybe I can finally understand where you’re coming from.
: Maybe it is?
: Maybe turning her into a “monster” is precisely what will save her? It saved you, did it not?
: It did not.
: Then you’ve given up on achieving any sort of happy ending? Of reaching a future where everyone’s dreams can come true?
: What...
: What do you mean by that?
: Nothing.
: Nothing at all.
: You need to accept, Akira-
: That sometimes?
: I just have to say things.
Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
: I don’t care what type of lesson it is. And I don’t care what sort of role you want me to play in Touka’s life.
: I just know that it’s different from what she wants. And that she hates you doing things like this even more than I do.
: What?
: Do you really hate it, Akira? Spending time with me like this?
: I came all the way to your house to see you. I nearly drank coffee from a communal pot. I apologized. And still you think I’m out to get you?
: What can I do to earn your trust? Your favor? In a way that does not separate me the way a woman like me begs to be separated.
: You’re just like Ami, Tsubasa.
: I mean...I don’t like incest that much. I just said I don’t automatically have a problem with it.
: Not that. Just...the way you two are always saying one thing, then doing something else. I can never take your words seriously because I don’t know the intent behind them.
: I’m not good at reading people. I’m good at...hooking up with them. Making them like me. I don’t know how, but that’s all I can do. I can’t ever really get them.
: So if you’re doing all of this stuff in hopes that something just clicks and I immediately understand what I need to do to make you and Touka happy, it’s not going to happen. I need you to tell me.
: Akira, I apologize, but I can not spoon-feed you. I am not your mother. I am Touka’s mother. Tsukasa’s mother. And I will always put them first- even if it doesn’t seem like it.
: Then what can I teach them that you can’t? What do I have at my disposal, huh? My body? Am I just a tool you can use to introduce them to the dark side of everything?
: Yes. That’s precisely what you are. But your reasoning is off.
: And just because you’re a tool doesn’t mean you aren’t indispensable. A surgeon is nothing without her scalpel. You wouldn’t want her carving into you with just her fingernails, would you?
: And you’re the surgeon here?
: If I were, would you let me reach inside your chest and hold your heart in my hands? I feel like it’s been alone for quite some time now.
: I’m too afraid you’d squeeze it until it erupts between your fingers.
: I’d never wash that hand again — and I’d wear the stains of your love on my flesh until death itself claims me.
: I want to go home, Tsubasa.
: You don’t want to find out what’s waiting for you at the manor?
: The manor is one thing.
: It’s what comes after that terrifies me.
EVENT CHAIN CANCELLED.
Tsubasa’s affection stagnates.
